value.text: An atom–cavity unit cellemits a single photon.
Routed into the entanglingbank, the photon meets fouratoms. Each CZ gate adds abond.
Routers steer the photononward to measurement.
A single-photon detectormeasures it in the X basis.
Detector data feeds real-timeerror-correction decoding.Control sets routing, photongeneration and atompreparation.
